commands: HOST=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /moodle/redis/endpoint --region $REGION --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null || echo '')
if [ -z "$HOST" ]; then echo 'No Redis endpoint found in SSM; aborting'; exit 1; fi
sudo yum -y -q install nmap-ncat || sudo dnf -y -q install nmap-ncat || true
if nc -z -w2 $HOST 6379 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'TCP 6379 reachable'; else echo 'TCP 6379 unreachable'; fi
